apps.name: led_blinker
apps.label: LED Blinker
apps.description: Blinks the on-board LED on a fixed cadence. The minimal example app.

apps.name: led_blinker_two
apps.label: LED Blinker (Two)
apps.description: A second blink app on a different pin/cadence, for testing multi-app builds.

apps.name: gpio_control
apps.label: GPIO Control
apps.description: Exposes a Helix service to read and drive GPIO pins remotely.

apps.name: status_display
apps.label: Status Display
apps.description: Reports device status/health over the Helix protocol.

apps.name: ui_demo
apps.label: UI Demo (LVGL)
apps.description: On-device LVGL screens streamed to a host viewer. Pulls in the LVGL UI stack and drops the on-device storage stack to fit.

apps.name: console_bridge
apps.label: Serial Console Bridge
apps.description: Bridges a target device's UART console to the Helix protocol so it can be driven remotely (field UART-to-network console server).

apps.name: sd_smoke
apps.label: SD Smoke Test
apps.description: Bring-up test for an SPI SD card sharing a GPT-partitioned card with a Radxa board. Probes the card, sanity-reads the GPT and the Helix partition, then writes/reads back a file clamped to that partition only.

apps.name: nrf24_smoke
apps.label: nRF24L01 Smoke Test
apps.description: Bring-up test for an nRF24L01(+) radio on SPI. Checks power-on register defaults, a 5-byte TX_ADDR round-trip that a floating bus cannot fake, the chip variant, and a MAX_RT transmit that exercises the CE and IRQ lines.
